# Setup Snippets

<!-- Generated by scripts/export_setup_snippets.py from testo_core/services/ci_templates.py. Edit those, not this page. -->

Copy-paste CI setup for each test runner and each CI system. Every snippet runs your tests the way they already run, has the runner write a result file Testosterone reads, and records it with no `testosterone.yaml`. Replace `my-app` with your project's name: runs recorded under the same cycle build its history.

Rather not copy anything? In the project folder, `pip install testo-core && testo init` detects the runners and writes these files for you, plus a `testosterone.yaml` so `testo run` works locally too ([Command Reference § testo init](../CLI%20Commands/Command%20Reference.md#testo-init)). `testo init --ci gitlab --dry-run` prints one without writing it.

How each CI keeps the history between runs:

- **GitHub Actions**: the action caches it (`history: auto`) and comments on pull requests. Inputs: [CI-CD Pipeline Setup § GitHub Action](CI-CD%20Pipeline%20Setup.md#github-action).
- **GitLab CI** and **CircleCI**: the snippet caches `.testo-history/` per branch, falling back to the default branch's.
- **Jenkins**: the history stays in the agent's workspace. For one history across agents and CI systems, run a [team server](Team%20Server.md) and replace `testo ingest ...` with `testo ingest --server https://your-server --token "$TESTO_API_TOKEN" ...`.

Outside GitHub, the snippets install `testo` with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (one binary that brings its own Python, so the image needs only `curl`). An image that has Python can run `pip install testo-core` instead. Each run's summary is saved as `testo-summary.md` next to the build.

## Python (pytest)

Test command: `mkdir -p test-results && pytest -q tests --junitxml=test-results/pytest.xml`

### Python (pytest): GitHub Actions

`.github/workflows/tests.yml`

```yaml
name: tests
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # the pull request comment
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: mkdir -p test-results && pytest -q tests --junitxml=test-results/pytest.xml
      - uses: taltal-beep/testosterone@v1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}  # record red runs too
        with:
          cycle: "my-app"
```

### Python (pytest): GitLab CI

`.gitlab-ci.yml`

```yaml
# Testosterone: records each run's results and keeps their history in the GitLab cache.
# Docs: https://taltal-beep.github.io/testosterone/docs/
stages: [test]

pytest:
  stage: test
  image: python:3.12
  cache:
    key: testo-history-pytest-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    fallback_keys: [testo-history-pytest-$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH]
    paths: [.testo-history/]
    when: always
  script:
    - pip install -r requirements.txt
    - mkdir -p test-results && pytest -q tests --junitxml=test-results/pytest.xml
  after_script:
    - command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
    - export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
    - uv tool install --quiet testo-core
    - mkdir -p "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.testo-history"
    - export DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.testo-history/testo_history.db"
    - testo ingest --cycle my-app
    - testo report markdown --cycle my-app --out testo-summary.md
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths: [testo-summary.md, test-results/]
```

### Python (pytest): Jenkins

`Jenkinsfile`

```groovy
// Testosterone: records each build's results. History lives in the workspace
// (.testo-history); for one history across agents, use a team server
// (testo ingest --server). Docs: https://taltal-beep.github.io/testosterone/docs/
pipeline {
  agent any  // needs the test tools and curl
  stages {
    stage('pytest') {
      steps {
        sh 'pip install -r requirements.txt'
        sh 'mkdir -p test-results && pytest -q tests --junitxml=test-results/pytest.xml'
      }
    }
  }
  post {
    always {
      sh '''
          command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          uv tool install --quiet testo-core
          mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.testo-history"
          export DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$WORKSPACE/.testo-history/testo_history.db"
          testo ingest --cycle my-app
          testo report markdown --cycle my-app --out testo-summary.md
      '''
      archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'testo-summary.md', allowEmptyArchive: true
    }
  }
}
```

### Python (pytest): CircleCI

`.circleci/config.yml`

```yaml
# Testosterone: records each run's results and keeps their history in the CircleCI cache.
# Docs: https://taltal-beep.github.io/testosterone/docs/
version: 2.1
jobs:
  pytest:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/python:3.12
    steps:
      - checkout
      - restore_cache:
          keys:
            - testo-history-pytest-{{ .Branch }}-
            - testo-history-pytest-
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: mkdir -p test-results && pytest -q tests --junitxml=test-results/pytest.xml
      - run:
          name: Record the results with Testosterone
          when: always
          command: |
            command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
            export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
            uv tool install --quiet testo-core
            mkdir -p "$HOME/.testo-history"
            export DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$HOME/.testo-history/testo_history.db"
            testo ingest --cycle my-app
            testo report markdown --cycle my-app --out testo-summary.md
      - save_cache:
          when: always
          key: testo-history-pytest-{{ .Branch }}-{{ .BuildNum }}
          paths: [~/.testo-history]
      - store_artifacts:
          path: testo-summary.md
workflows:
  tests:
    jobs:
      - pytest
```

## JavaScript (Jest)

Test command: `mkdir -p test-results && npx jest --ci --json --outputFile=test-results/jest.json`

### JavaScript (Jest): GitHub Actions

`.github/workflows/tests.yml`

```yaml
name: tests
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # the pull request comment
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: mkdir -p test-results && npx jest --ci --json --outputFile=test-results/jest.json
      - uses: taltal-beep/testosterone@v1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}  # record red runs too
        with:
          cycle: "my-app"
```

## Browser tests (Playwright)

Test command: `mkdir -p test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/playwright.json npx playwright test --reporter=list,json`

### Browser tests (Playwright): GitHub Actions

`.github/workflows/tests.yml`

```yaml
name: tests
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # the pull request comment
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: mkdir -p test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/playwright.json npx playwright test --reporter=list,json
      - uses: taltal-beep/testosterone@v1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}  # record red runs too
        with:
          cycle: "my-app"
```

## Go (go test)

Test command: `mkdir -p test-results && go test -json ./... > test-results/go-test.json`

### Go (go test): GitHub Actions

`.github/workflows/tests.yml`

```yaml
name: tests
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # the pull request comment
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - run: mkdir -p test-results && go test -json ./... > test-results/go-test.json
      - uses: taltal-beep/testosterone@v1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}  # record red runs too
        with:
          cycle: "my-app"
```
